# ZainBot

> ZainBot (زين بوت) is an AI customer-conversation workspace for small businesses, in Arabic and English. Merchants build AI agents that answer customers across connected channels, and manage orders, bookings and follow-ups from one dashboard. There is a free plan, no credit card required.

## Who it is for

Small businesses, online stores and service providers (clinics, salons, restaurants and similar) that get customer messages on WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram, Telegram or a website chat, and want AI replies in Arabic or English plus order and booking handling. It is not an API product and has no public API for agents.
